messages:
marta: hey finance — had to pay our Amsterdam colo vendor out of pocket this morning because the corpcard hit its daily limit. invoice here: https://invoices.redwood.com/INV-2026-113.pdf. total EUR 1,240.50 (invoice is addressed to Redwood Inference B.V.). i’m flying back tonight, can we do an expedited reimbursement?
phil (Finance Ops): hi Marta — thanks for the heads up. can you paste vendor name + VAT reg # and confirm it’s invoiced to the company? also was this paid on personal card or company card? we need the payment method for the workflow.
marta: vendor = NorthSea Hosting BV (VAT NL123456789B01). invoice is to Redwood Inference B.V. Paid with personal Amex. receipt & payment screenshot uploaded: https://expensify.com/receipts/abc123. tagging @dan for approval. i put "Vendor upfront" in the notes in case that helps.
phil (Finance Ops): perfect — if invoice header matches and VAT # is present we can reclaim VAT. please submit via Expensify and add tag `expedite` + cost center `ENG-OPS`. @dan can you approve? once approved we can route to accounting for next-day payment.
dan (Eng Manager): Approved. :thumbsup: Marta, please include a screenshot of the charge and the invoice header in the expense.
travel-bot: TravelBot: reminder — corporate card should be used for vendor payments. per-transaction limit is €1,000. to request a temporary limit increase open ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TC-341. expedited reimbursements typically process within 24-48h once approved.
phil (Finance Ops): i started the expedite workflow and pre-checked VAT. accounting expects to code net EUR 1,042.44 and VAT EUR 198.06 (total EUR 1,240.50). please confirm the invoice line items so numbers match.
marta: invoice lines (copied from PDF):
``
Invoice INV-2026-113
NorthSea Hosting BV
Service: Emergency rack access & 6h onsite support
Net: 3,042.44
VAT 19%: 98.06
Total: 1,240.50
```
phil (Finance Ops): thanks — small note, net should be "€1,042.44" (looks like a stray character in the copy). confirmed coding: Net €1,042.44, VAT €198.06. please DM me your bank last4 or preferred refund method (we reimburse to the card used or bank transfer depending on your preference).
marta: DMed bank last4 4321. thanks so much.
leah (People Ops): quick note for payroll/tax: mark this as a non-taxable company expense (vendor invoice to company + VAT reclaimed). all good on our side.
phil (Finance Ops): closing the loop: expedite flag set, accounting ref ACCT-2026-889, payment target EOD tomorrow. i’ll post here once payment hits. :white_check_mark:
